TEXT: The day after the tournament.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Akihabara is bustling as ever.
This area is often seen as an "Otaku's Den", but really, it's quite sophisticated.
The public square in front of the station is pretty clean; it makes the place spacious and relaxing.
Saori and Kuroneko have already arrived and are sitting on a bench in the public square.
Oh right, the first time that I met Saori and Kuroneko was in Akihabara as well...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Well then, to celebrate the end of the tournament, to the holy land we came!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Let's go shop around since we're here, alright?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Shopping...
There wouldn't be any atmosphere to it if we were to celebrate immediately. This might be good to raise the tension.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, alright. Do you guys agree?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: It's fine with me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I don't mind; do what you want.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You heard them, Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I got it! Well then, where should we go first?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Is there any place that you'd recommend?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Every place in Akihabara is recommended... Hmm...
And so Saori pondered for a while.
She's probably searching through the endless "Akiba-data" inside her head.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: How about we go to 【Radio Kaikan】 or 【AniMate】?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kyousuke-shi, do you have any places that you would like to visit?
...*gulp*
It seems simple enough, but in reality, the answer may be of crucial importance.
If I were to choose a place they don't care about, I'm sure that it would turn into some quarrel again.
Hmm... Where should we go?
Also, I shouldn't choose a tiring place...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What do we actually do at Radio Kaikan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What's wrong? W-W-W-What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Radio Kaikan! I want to go to Radio Kaikan!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's with Radio Kaikan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Because Radio Kaikan has a figurine shop and there's a special 【Sis×Sis】 booth that started selling limited edition goodies!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sis×Sis - Sister Sister: Siscon Love Story?
...*sigh*.
I'm getting quite familiar with such topics.
The contents are... that of a bishoujo game.
Because the story is about having a love triangle relationship with your little sisters "Rinko" and "Miyabi", my head hurts.
According to Kirino, it's a "tear-jerking" "godly game". But I frankly don't get it.
However, I do know how to make my own little sister cry...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Stop dilly-dallying! They'll be sold out if we don't hurry up!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: They won't be sold out that quickly. Calm down a bit. You'll hurt yourself if you panic.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Sis×Sis is a "godly game"!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, hey! Don't run!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Damn! I want this! This too! And that too!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A-Aren't you buying too much?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Shut it! How I spend my own money is up to me!
This girl, she practically spent all her wages earned as a model, on "Sis×Sis"...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: What a big haul! I'm so happy!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Isn't that great, Kiririn-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It isn't that bad to observe humans acting like that every once in a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You're still speaking like that～ I can lend them to you if you're interested.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Wha...? Who said such a thing...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Look, look. You want to try them out too, don't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hahaha! Deepening mutual bonds through games! Ah, how wonderful!
Well, she's looking all happy and everything... Oh well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What do you do in AniMate?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Ohh! As expected of Kyousuke-shi, good choice!
Saori shaped her mouth like that of a cat, and threw her head back.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: It seems that today, there's Morimura Kaede-dono doing an autograph session at AniMate!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Seriously?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: This is true, is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Who's that?
Not just Kirino, but even the usually expressionless Kuroneko had a reaction... This person must really be something.
Recently, I've been getting more and more familiar with "that genre of topics", but I'm still an amateur after all.
Just hearing the name isn't enough for me to recognize it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Holy crap! We have to hurry! DASH!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, hey! Don't run!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Oh man... I can't stop shaking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I can't believe I got to shake hands with Morimura Kaede-san... This isn't a dream, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Even for an Akihabara veteran like me, it's been a long time since I got so excited...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It was quite impressive...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Did you see? Kaede-san held my hand gently and winked at me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Wasn't yours just a normal blink? The one she gave me was a wink.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I've decided! I will never wash my hands!
Uwah... That's such a classic reaction...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kyousuke-shi, thank you very much for considering my feelings.
Saying that, Saori held out her hands to me. Then...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Ah, well. It's not like that...
I held out my right hand...
Careful now!!
I held out my left hand and shook hands with Saori...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...By the way, what kind of person is Morimura Kaede?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kaede-shi is not only a writer, but also a singer, model and star; truly a multi-talented person!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Rumor has it she's participating in a Broadway musical next...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: That's amazing, isn't it! I totally admire her!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, I see.
...I don't.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't mind where we go....

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I see... That's a shame.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Eeeh? We've already come to Akiba, so I wanna go somewhere at least!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: That's right, the four of us are together now. Vainly wasting our time goes against the rules of my soul.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You mean you want to have fun, right? You're being way too cryptic.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Would you stop summarizing other people's speeches...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hahaha, you two sure get along with each other.
I get exhausted every time I go around Akiba with these girls.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Then what about relaxing in a Maid Cafe?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh! That's a good idea!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Huh...
Ignoring Kirino's lingering glare, we headed for a Maid Cafe.
